upsc_summary: ISRO successfully launched the GSLV-F18/NVS-03 mission, injecting the NVS-03 satellite into a Geosynchronous Transfer Orbit (GTO).
NVS-03 is the 3rd of 5 planned second-generation navigation satellites (NVS series) designed to augment and sustain the Navigation with Indian Constellation (NavIC).
Payload & Frequency Bands: NVS-03 operates across L1, L5, and S frequency bands. The addition of the L1 signal enhances interoperability with civil GNSS systems like GPS.
Indigenous Atomic Clock: Carries an indigenously developed Rubidium atomic clock alongside imported clocks to provide accurate timing references critical for positioning.
NavIC Capabilities: Provides Standard Positioning Service (SPS) for civilian users and encrypted Restricted Service (RS) for strategic users, covering India and a 1,500 km region beyond its borders.
Launch Vehicle: GSLV is a 3-stage vehicle featuring an indigenous Cryogenic Upper Stage (LOX/LH2 propellants) and liquid strap-on boosters (L-40).

Key Cheetah Habitats in MP: Kuno National Park (Sheopur district, Vindhyachal range) serves as the primary site, followed by Gandhi Sagar Wildlife Sanctuary (2nd site) and Veerangana Durgavati Tiger Reserve (3rd site added in Oct 2026).

Historical Background: Native Asiatic cheetahs were officially declared extinct in India in 1952 (last recorded sighting in 1947 in Koriya, Chhattisgarh) due to hunting, habitat loss, and low reproductive rates.

Genetics & Breeding Milestones: African cheetahs sourced from Namibia, South Africa, and Botswana; successful breeding of F1 (India-born) generation inside Kuno strengthens genetic diversity and metapopulation resilience.

Ecosystem & Community Integration: Serves as an umbrella species for restoring open forests and grasslands; involves local communities through 450+ 'Cheetah Mitras', direct employment, and sharing 5% of eco-tourism revenues.

title: TRAI releases “The Telecommunication Interconnection (Reference Interconnect Offer) (Amendment) Regulations, 2026”
date:
प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                27 NOV 2026 4:52PM by PIB Delhi
upsc_summary: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) issued 'The Telecommunication Interconnection (Reference Interconnect Offer) (Amendment) Regulations, 2026', coming into force on January 1, 2027.

Significant Market Power (SMP): Mandates that a service provider holding a 30% or more market share across parameters (Adjusted Gross Revenue, Subscriber Base, Voice Call Capacity, or Traffic Volume) will be designated as having SMP.
Time-Bound Interconnection: SMP entities must submit their Reference Interconnect Offer (RIO) to TRAI within 30 days of determination and publish approved terms on their website within 15 days.
LSA-Level Routing: Replaces obsolete SDCA/LDCA-based interconnection routing with Licensed Service Area (LSA)-level IP-based packet-switched network architecture.
Enforcement Framework: Introduces a graded financial disincentives system for contraventions related to non-submission, non-publication, or delayed reporting of RIO data.
